name: Rikers Island
text: Rikers Island is a 413-acre (167.14-hectare) prison island in the East River in the Bronx, New York City, United States, that contains New York City's largest jail. It is named after Abraham Rycken, who took possession of the island in 1664. The island was originally under 100 acres (40 ha) in size, but has since grown to more than 400 acres (160 ha).

depictions.name: Rikers Island
depictions.text: The Rikers Island, is a notorious maximum-security prison located in New York City's East River. Following the outbreak of the Green Poison virus, Rikers Island transforms from a correctional facility into a chaotic stronghold controlled by the Rikers, a brutal faction of escaped inmates.
